about: Where Meko's data folder is, for paths.Resolve and for AgentK's mekoHome() (src/extensions/agentk/src/server/paths.ts), which puts its home in <data folder>/extensions/agentk. Both test suites read this file, so the two rules stay the same. In paths, $HOME is the home folder, $SHARED_TMP the shared local folder (/var/tmp) and $USER the user's name. networkDirs are the folders on a network filesystem: a path is on one when it is one of them or under one. want is the data folder, or error is true when Resolve refuses.
